faq.a: Roxy is one of the two members of Real Dimez, a rap duo she formed with longtime friend Bae-Luxe. The pair have been friends since high school.

faq.q: Is Roxy part of Real Dimez in GTA 6?
faq.a: Yes. Rockstar names Roxy alongside Bae-Luxe as the two members of Real Dimez, describing them together rather than in separate individual biographies.

faq.q: Has Roxy signed to a record label in GTA 6?
faq.a: Real Dimez signed to Only Raw Records after five years and substantial trouble, and the duo are seeking another breakthrough. That label connection applies to Roxy as one of the group's two members.

faq.q: Did Roxy work with the rapper DWNPLY?
faq.a: Real Dimez had an early hit single with local rapper DWNPLY, which helped raise the duo's profile. Rockstar does not separate Roxy's individual contribution from Bae-Luxe's.

faq.q: What is Roxy's personal background outside of Real Dimez?
faq.a: Rockstar has not said. The available biography describes the two women together and does not provide a separate detailed personal history for Roxy alone.
